input.reasoning_summary:
All three challenges have been refuted or found to have no relevant evidence:

H1 (Was net income positive?) - CHALLENGE_REFUTED: The numeric computation confirms net income for Q2 2026 was $112,193 million (positive), compared to $28,196 million in Q2 2025. This represents a YoY growth of approximately 298%, confirming net income was indeed positive and substantially boosted.

H2 (Are equity gains considered operating performance?) - NO_RELEVANT_EVIDENCE: The retrieved evidence does not indicate that equity security gains are considered part of operating performance or core business results. The original evidence already showed these gains appear in "Other Income (Expense), Net" which is separate from operating income, and no new evidence contradicts this.

H3 (Were gains offset by losses?) - CHALLENGE_REFUTED: Net income increased from $28.2 billion in Q2 2025 to $112.2 billion in Q2 2026, an increase of $84 billion. This is consistent with the ~$99 billion in equity security gains reported for the quarter, confirming that net income was indeed "boosted" on a net basis despite any offsetting items.

The claim remains SUPPORTED. The evidence confirms that: (1) Alphabet reported net income of $112.2 billion for Q2 2026; (2) this included $99.0 billion in gains on equity securities; (3) these gains were unrealized gains from investments in SpaceX and a private company; and (4) these gains appear in "Other Income (Expense), Net" rather than operating income, supporting the assertion that they "do not reflect operating performance."
